title: Implement YAP mode: conversational LLM refinement for transcriptions
description:
YAP mode allows users to iteratively refine transcribed text through conversation with a local LLM (Ollama) before pasting. 

Features needed:
- Toggle YAP mode in config (enabled for testing)
- Ollama integration (default model: granite)
- Conversation history tracking
- Iterative refinement loop
- Revision history display
- Compact final output before paste
- Only for Linux build initially

User workflow:
1. Record speech as normal
2. Instead of immediate paste, enter YAP mode
3. Transcription sent to LLM for initial refinement
4. User can continue recording to add context/refinement requests
5. LLM produces progressively more refined versions
6. User confirms final version to paste

This helps verbose users (yappers) create concise, well-crafted messages.

title: Fix Wayland audio recording to use internal Zig AudioRecorder instead of external arecord script
description:
The Wayland daemon mode was using an external bash script with arecord to capture audio, which caused device selection issues and added unnecessary dependencies. 

Fixed by:
1. Adding internal AudioRecorder to Wayland daemon (same as X11 mode)
2. Implementing proper state transitions for recording/processing
3. Simplifying toggle script to only send WebSocket commands
4. Removing arecord dependency - Zig handles all audio via PulseAudio
5. Reduced event loop delay from 10ms to 1ms for faster hotkey response
6. Reduced audio chunk size from 4096 bytes (256ms) to 512 bytes (16ms) for faster stop response

This reduces dependencies, ensures correct audio device is used from config, and provides snappy response times.
close_reason: Implemented async PulseAudio stream with pre-initialization. Recording now starts instantly (18.5ms vs 47ms). Added 350ms grace period for trailing words. Merged to master.
